actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.InboxServices.run#Operation').parameters({operation: 'get#ThreadView', parameters: {store: store || '', threadId: threadId || ''}}).call()?.result || {} ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {thread: out.thread})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.InboxServices.run#Operation').parameters({operation: 'search#LinkRecords', parameters: {term: term || ''}}).call()?.result || {} ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? [] : (out.optionList || []))

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.InboxServices.run#Operation').parameters({operation: 'get#MailboxHeader', parameters: {contactListId: contactListId || ''}}).call()?.result || {} ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {mailbox: out.mailbox})

const list = (text) => text ? String(text).split(',').map((id) => id.trim()).filter((id) => id) : [] const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.InboxServices.run#Operation').parameters({operation: 'apply#ViewAction', parameters: {view: view || null, emailAccountId: account || null, emailFolderId: folder || null, emailLabelId: label || null, contactListId: mailbox || null, searchText: q || null, unreadOnly: String(unreadOnly) === 'true', action: action || '', snoozedThruDate: snoozedThruDate ? new Date(Number(snoozedThruDate)) : null, targetEmailFolderId: emailFolderId || null, addLabelIdList: list(addLabelIds), removeLabelIdList: list(removeLabelIds), clientRef: clientRef || null}}).call()?.result || {} ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {updatedCount: out.updatedCount, failedList: out.failedList, threadCount: out.threadCount, duplicate: out.duplicate === true})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.MailSettingsServices.sync#UserAccounts').parameter('emailAccountId', emailAccountId || null).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {startedList: out.startedList, failedList: out.failedList})
ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.mail.EmailClientServices.delete#EmailSearch').parameter('emailSearchId', emailSearchId || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({})
